scope: Bounded producer design for the 162 reviewed OOD-N04 objects: 144 new-ID replacements and 18 same-ID corrections, reconstructing the exact v19a predecessor and reusing the established 19a-to-11 validation chain.

findings.basis: The two explicit identity classes preserve truthful current mapping counts while making same-ID historical restoration explicit.

Fixed descriptors, exact source and question-set hashes, whole-object equality, historical row hashes, and byte-exact predecessor reconstruction form a closed validation path without widening the existing 19a private N03 buffer allowance.

Register the new focused package-20 test file once in the explicit test:canonical command in patternly-content/package.json so the repository's existing canonical suite executes it. This is existing test-command wiring, not a new acceptance gate.

limitations: This is design approval only; it does not establish producer implementation correctness, consumer synchronization, admission, native behavior, release readiness, or full BIZQ-01 completion.
Implementation still needs to produce the actual source, historical reconstruction, negative-test, canonical-suite, and build evidence specified in the briefing.
